channel_name: International Development Association - Multilateral Debt Relief Initiative
rationale: IDA folds MDRI disbursements into its main 44002 CRS reporting rather than filing a separate purpose-code stream; same governing institution and reporting channel. Judgement call: MDRI core money is spread across IDA's lending mix rather than shown as debt relief (IDA reports $148.5m purpose 60020 against $76,162m of ODA, 2022-2024), on the basis that MDRI payments replenish IDA's lending capacity.

channel_name: International Development Association - Heavily Indebted Poor Countries Debt Initiative Trust Fund
rationale: IDA folds HIPC trust-fund disbursements into its main 44002 CRS reporting rather than filing a separate purpose-code stream; same governing institution and reporting channel.
ADB (provider 915) reports $166bn to CRS as a single institution; the Asian Development Fund has zero CRS presence of its own under 46005.
